environment_blocker.closure: exact current head produces a digest-valid V2 receipt with PASS_CI_EXECUTION_ONLY
environment_blocker.dynamic_head_rule: resolve pull request head SHA at evidence capture time
environment_blocker.interpretation: runner, billing, policy or Actions allocation failure; not a code PASS and not an executed code-test failure

acceptance: all three canonical required workflows target one exact PR head
every required job has runner_id greater than zero and one or more steps
workflow, job and every step are terminal non-failure with at least one successful step
jobs total_count and repository/run URL bindings are exact
dependencies: repository-or-organization Actions policy and billing recovery
